scripts.fetch-data: node scripts/fetch-quran.mjs && node scripts/fetch-hadith.mjs && node scripts/build-prophets-data.mjs && node scripts/build-tajwid-data.mjs
scripts.check-gradient: powershell -Command "$g = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Recurse -Include *.ts,*.tsx,*.css | Select-String -Pattern 'gradient' -CaseSensitive:$false; if ($g) { Write-Error 'Gradient detected in src!'; exit 1 } else { Write-Host 'No gradients found. All flat colors!' }"
scripts.deploy:zip: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path out) { Compress-Archive -Path out/* -DestinationPath iqra.zip -Force; Write-Host 'Created iqra.zip successfully!' } else { Write-Error 'out/ folder not found. Run npm run build first!' }"
